title: Phone and Internet in Tanzania: SIM Cards and eSIMs
excerpt: Staying connected in Tanzania is easy with a local SIM card or an eSIM. What to know about coverage in parks and registration.
body:
Mobile internet is widely available in Tanzania, but coverage in remote parks is limited.

## Local SIM card

Major providers have shops in cities and at airports. SIM cards must be registered with your passport, and biometric registration is required. It takes some time, so go to an official shop.

## eSIM

If your phone supports it, an eSIM from an international provider is an easy alternative. Activate it before or on arrival.

## Coverage

- Good in cities and towns.
- Variable in parks: central Serengeti and the Ngorongoro rim often have some signal; remote areas have none.
- Many lodges have Wi-Fi, sometimes only in the main area.

## Roaming

Roaming with a European provider can be expensive. Check your rates.

## Digital detox

Many travellers enjoy being offline on safari.
